text:
maria: Quick sync thread on automatic fallback UX for rollouts. Two main problems: 1) users can't easily understand WHY a fallback fired, 2) audit traces are hard to replay. Throwing a small proto below for discussion.

maria: ```yaml
policy: rollouts/fastpath-eval
triggers:
  - kind: p99_latency
    threshold_ms: 1200
  - kind: error_rate
    status_family: 5xx
    pct: 0.02
mode: degrade_soft # keep partial features
fallback: model-small-v2-quant
audit_level: full
notifications:
  slack: [eng-oncall]
  metric: rollout.fallback_event
```

sam: Nice. Quick Q: what does degrade_soft mean in the UI? Users will ask if it changes outputs.

alex: UX def: soft = preserve response shape (headers, tokens) but shorten generated tokens and prefer cached prefills. hard = immediate model swap and full feature loss. :thinking:

jen: Console idea: show a compact tag on the route like `Auto-fallback: latency` with a hover tooltip showing the trigger (p99 >1200ms) and a timestamp. Click expands to a timeline: trigger -> policy eval -> action -> verification. Add a "Replay with sample" button to simulate the decision against retained sanitized requests.

kevin: Telemetry requirements: every decision record must include these fields: trigger_kind, trigger_value, policy_id, source_model, target_model, latency_before_ms, latency_after_ms, sample_request_id, decision_id, is_replay(bool). Without this we can't stitch traces to metrics.

lia: Pill text should be human readable: e.g. `latency spike (p99 1450ms)` and have a copy link to the decision record. If audit_level == full show a green badge, otherwise a warning icon.

maria: Need an escape hatch (manual hold) scoped to the rollout. SRE should be able to pause auto-fallback for X minutes. Where does that live? policy editor or rollout controls?

sam: Put it per-rollout. Common flow: pause auto-fallback for 30m during noisy deploys. Global pause is dangerous.

alex: API note: decision logs must be append-only and include an idempotency key so replay/simulation references exact rows. Also include a compact serialized policy evaluation trace.

jen: For audit playback: show the original (sanitized) inputs, the policy evaluation checklist (which triggers matched, thresholds), and the chosen action. Highlight anomalies (out-of-bound values) with a red outline. Keep initial messages compact, expand for full payload.

kevin: PII/Risk: sanitize by default. Keep a restricted raw-sample blob in a separate store with RBAC gating. Playback shows sanitized sample and a `Request details (restricted)` link for users with permission.

ops-bot: Incident watch: no active incidents on affected clusters.

deploy-bot: Deployment applied: rollouts/fastpath-eval -> route chat/generate (2 replicas) by @maria.

maria: Another piece: small grouped timeline in route logs that aggregates auto-fallback events and links to decision_id. Also show a confidence score that indicates how many triggers matched and their severity.

sam: Implementation detail: triggers must be composable (`latency AND 5xx`) and include holdout windows to avoid flapping. Expose a debounce window in the UI.

alex: Add a shadowing mode: route a sampled subset to the fallback model in shadow (no traffic switch) and report quality deltas. UI should show shadow success/failure rates and a small diffs panel (sample outputs + quality metrics).

jen: Shadowing is great. UI: show shadow acceptance rate, avg latency delta, cost delta, and a small sample diff of completions. Allow pinning specific samples for deeper inspection.

kevin: Ops requirement: when we auto-fallback emit a trace span with `decision_id` and increment `fallback_rate` metric per route/model. Also annotate traces so we can correlate produced tokens with decision.

lia: Design note: include a lightweight share link for a decision record so engineers can paste an RFC-like link in PRs/incidents. Controlled by acl.

maria: Action items: 
- kevin: draft telemetry/decision log proto + required fields (EOD)
- jen/lia: mock pill, timeline, playback, and restricted payload flow (EOW)
- alex/sam: API for idempotent decisions + shadowing orchestration spike
- infra: ensure traces/metrics include decision_id and provide RBAC for raw-sample store

kevin: will drop a proto by EOD.

jen: will deliver mock by EOW, include error states and copy flows.

sam: I'll spike shadow infra and share perf notes (+expected cost) next week.

lia: Tagging: @maria @kevin @jen @sam @alex @deploy-bot @ops-bot @infra.

maria: Thanks all. Let's keep iteration quick — this is getting asked by a few PLG customers. :eyes:

kevin: FYI: proto will include `sanitization_level` + `restricted_blob_ref`.

jen: UX follow-up: add keyboard shortcuts on timeline (j/k to move events) and a compact summary card for slack links.

maria: final: consider adding an "auto-verify" step where after fallback triggers we run a small quality check (sample scoring) and only persist fallback if quality loss < threshold. Otherwise auto-unwind. Thoughts?

alex: Love it. That can reduce false positives. We can combine with shadowing results as the verification signal.

ops-bot: Reminder: keep replay traffic rate limited to avoid influencing production SLOs.

maria: Note saved. We'll reconvene after mocks + proto. :thumbsup:
